Title: ONNX Semantic Embeddings
Content: MemorySmith.App has an optional local ONNX embedding path for memory semantic search. SemanticSearchOptions default to ../Data/Models/embedding-model.onnx and ../Data/Models/vocab.txt; ONNX/model artifacts are ignored by Git. OnnxTextEmbeddingProvider loads the model lazily through Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime, tokenizes text with a local WordPiece vocabulary, applies E5-style query:/passage: prefixes, mean-pools token outputs when needed, normalizes vectors, and reports availability through /api/diagnostics and /health. SemanticEmbeddingSearchService performs exact in-memory cosine ranking across the filtered memory set. MemoryApplicationService falls back to the existing token/tag/title/reference/alias scorer when embeddings are disabled, missing assets, or model inference fails. Hybrid search continues to fuse Lucene lexical rank with the active semantic rank via RRF.
